WITH lock_check AS (
  SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(104104) AS acquired
)
SELECT 
  lock_check.acquired,
  d.id,
  d.tenant_id,
  d.domain,
  d.proposed_payload,
  d.outcome_type,
  d.final_payload,
  d.feedback_note,
  d.delta_analysis,
  d.created_at
FROM lock_check
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT id, tenant_id, domain, proposed_payload, outcome_type, final_payload, feedback_note, delta_analysis, created_at
  FROM decision_outcomes
  WHERE tenant_id = COALESCE($1, 'default')
    AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  ORDER BY created_at ASC
  LIMIT 25
) d ON lock_check.acquired = true;

SELECT create_learning_candidate(
  $1,
  'rafael',
  $2,
  $3,
  $4,
  $5,
  $6::numeric,
  $7,
  $8::integer,
  $9,
  $10,
  NULL
) AS candidate_id, $11 AS text, $12::bigint AS chat_id;
